reference.title: Scenario 16 — Block Image Between Numbered List in a Procedure
reference.shortdesc: Consider a numbered procedure where the author has inserted a full-width screenshot between two steps

section.p: Consider a numbered procedure where the author has inserted a full-width screenshot between two steps — for example, to illustrate what the screen looks like after completing step one.

entry.codeblock:
Open the Application

  1. Open the application.
  2. Click File > Open .

<task id="open_application"> <title>Open the Application</title> <taskbody> <steps> <step> <cmd>Open the application.</cmd> <info> <fig> <title>The application main window</title> <image href="media/screenshot.png"> <alt>Application main window</alt> </image> </fig> </info> </step> <step> <cmd> Click <menucascade> <uicontrol>File</uicontrol> <uicontrol>Open</uicontrol> </menucascade>. </cmd> </step> </steps> </taskbody> </task>

section.p: Result: The converter treats the <figure> element nested inside a <li> as supporting content for that step and moves it into the preceding <step><info> element, so that the task remains a single continuous <steps> structure.
